$comment: Known advisories accepted after review. Every entry needs a reason and a reviewBy date; the audit check fails when an entry expires or a new high/critical advisory appears. Re-check whether a fixed Prisma 7.x exists before extending a date.

advisories.reason: Pulled in only by the Prisma CLI's config loader (@prisma/config), which merges our own prisma.config.ts object. No user input reaches it. The only npm fix is a major downgrade to Prisma 6, which breaks the Prisma 7 adapter setup.
MySQL driver bundled with the Prisma CLI. This app only uses PostgreSQL through @prisma/adapter-pg; mysql2 is never loaded or connected.
Same MySQL driver as above (compressed MySQL protocol). Never loaded; no MySQL connections exist.
